conclusion: Within the accepted current-item domain, signed city +0x38 values at least 100 enter the non-unit path. Item-minus-100 below 100 uses the 0x82D16128 cost call; signed city +0x36 is compared with returned r3 and branches away when invested production is less, while the sufficient path first stores invested minus cost to city +0x36. The accepted wonder range repeats the cost call at 0x82D162B0, preserves returned r3 in r28, performs the same signed threshold, and after two additional neutral gates first stores invested minus cost to +0x36, current item to +0x3A, and a bit-cleared word to +0x24. These are threshold and first-write facts only. There is no proved local item-less-than-300 guard, and complete production behavior, field meanings, downstream helpers, later writes, runtime execution, and implementation safety remain unresolved.
